children: India's central bank on Friday announced an open market sale of bonds, one of the most potent liquidity-draining tools, hours after its chief said in a media interview that all options remained on the table.

The Reserve Bank of India will sell bonds maturing in fiscal 2029 to fiscal 2032 worth 1 trillion rupees ($10.47 billion) in its first net sale of bonds in two years, after it sold notes in the secondary market in September 2024.
The central bank had conducted simultaneous purchase and sale of bonds in fiscal 2021 and 2022.
